name: SBC Roofing (Strategy Builders Contracting LLC)
subject: 🏠 Your roofing site has a section about pool ownership
body:
Hi Abraham,

I spent a few minutes on the SBC Roofing site and two things stood out. Your homepage lists three different phone numbers, so a Tucson homeowner has to guess which one to call. And sitting in the middle of your roofing pages is a section called 'The Joy of Pool Ownership', leftover template text about swimming pools on a roofing company site.

Small stuff on the surface, but it makes a real roofing company look unfinished.

So I redesigned the homepage for you, and the finished design is attached to this email as a PDF. One phone number throughout, (520) 373-9143, the same one painted on your truck. The pool section is gone, and your roofing work, your licenses and your free inspections sit right up front.

Websites for contractors are what I do. I built Leal Roofing (leal-roofing.com), a straightforward site with one clear number and the services laid out properly. Severe Weather Roofing (severeweatherroofing.com) is another of mine, built for storm work where trust matters most.

Worth five minutes of your time whenever you are ready. If it does not look better than what you have now, you have lost nothing.

Best,
Hassan
